chapter_seo_title: Ji Ning Meets Nine Lotos After a Decade – A Dao-Companion Bond Revealed
chapter_meta_description: Ji Ning and Yu Wei debate the brutal tier-list of the Immortal Destiny Gathering. Nine Lotos returns after ten years, and a Dao-companion bond is revealed—leaving one observer in silent heartbreak.
og_title: The Dao-Companion Bond: Ji Ning’s Romantic Milestone
og_description: Yu Wei reveals her tragic past, then Nine Lotos arrives to claim her place beside Ji Ning. A chapter of power-talk, hidden pain, and a quiet smile that says everything.
twitter_title: Ji Ning x Nine Lotos: Official
twitter_description: The Immortal Destiny Gathering looms, Yu Wei drops a heartbreaking origin story, and Ji Ning’s Dao-companion steps out of the shadows. + Northson is mad about golems.

lore_anchors.definition: A grand tournament for Wanxiang Adepts across the Grand Xia Dynasty, held before they break through to the Primal stage. It is the only chance for geniuses to showcase their talent to the major powers of the world and be accepted as disciples.

A cultivator who failed their Heavenly Tribulation in a past life but managed to reincarnate with their soul intact, retaining fragments of past-life memories and secret arts that give them an edge over ordinary cultivators.
The Daoist title of Yu Wei, a reincarnated Immortal of the Black-White College and one of the top Wanxiang Adepts in the Anchan Commandery.
A cultivation partner bound by a shared Dao-heart and lifelong commitment; more than a romantic spouse, a Dao-companion is a spiritual and martial ally on the path of cultivation.

A rarely cultivated path focused on creating mechanical constructs by perfecting the physical properties of materials. Considered a dead end for immortality, as no major power in history has ever fully comprehended it.
Ji Ning’s secluded home territory in the Yan Mountains, where he scattered his parents’ ashes. It has become a sanctuary and gathering place for his closest friends and Dao-companions.
A secret cultivation ground of the Dongyan clan, used to isolate Nine Lotos for ten years in an attempt to break her bond with Ji Ning.
An ancient and supremely powerful noble clan of the Grand Xia Dynasty, possessing Earth Immortal-level ancestors and commanding immense authority.

cultural_notes_faq.q: Why are golem-users banned from the Immortal Destiny Gathering?
cultural_notes_faq.a: Because there has never been a major power (Daofather or Celestial Immortal) who has fully mastered the Dao of Golems. Since the Gathering’s purpose is to select disciples for these powers, a golem-user would have no potential mentor at the highest levels.

cultural_notes_faq.q: Why does Yu Wei stay silent at the end?
cultural_notes_faq.a: She has developed feelings for Ji Ning but chooses not to interfere with his newly revealed Dao-companion bond with Nine Lotos, her close friend. Her faint smile masks personal heartbreak with grace.
